entries.latin:
Frater Heilmannus abbas monasterij schonaugiensis
ordinis cysterciensis wormaciensis dyocesis, conmissarius seu
vices gerens in hac parte reuerendi in Christo patris ac dominj
nostri domini Johannis episcopi wormaciensis, apostolice sedis
nuncij, conmissarij ab eadem sede ad infrascripta specialiter deputati,
subdeputatus, recognoscimus publice ac omnibus et singulis quorum
interest uel intererit lucide patefacimus in hijs scriptis, quod nos
vice loco et nomine eiusdem reuerendi patris dominj Johannis
episcopi wormaciensis, conmissarij principalis, necnon camere
apostolice et pro ipsa camera a venerabilibus viris dominjs .. decano
et capitulo ecclesie herbipolensis et ipsorum ac dicte eorum ec-
clesie ex parte et pro ipsis potestate nobis per eundem dominum Jo-
hannem episcopum specialiter tradita et iniuncta recepimus quadrin-
gentos florenos boni ponderis et auri in pecunia prompta et numerata
nobis vice et nomine eorumdem dominorum .. decani et capituli et eorum
ecclesie per strennuos armigeros Eberhardum iuniorem de Rosen-
berg et Johannem iuniorem de Rosenberg presentatos datos et
assignatos ac traditos loco mediorum fructuum archidyaconatus et
prebende ac eciam oblagiorum, quem quam et que reuerendissimus
in Christo pater dominus Nycolaus episcopus tusculanus, sacro-
sancte romane ecclesie cardinalis, archidyaconus et canonicus ec-
clesie herbipolensis predicte, habet in eadem ecclesia, in quibus
eidem domino cardinali .. decanus et capitulum predicti racione
arrendacionis per eos facte de fructibus archidyaconatus prebende
et oblagiorum predictorum extiterant obligati, jn quibus eciam qua-
dringentis florenis loco mediorum fructuum prefatus dominus cardi-
nalis camere apostolice predicte fore dinoscitur obligatus.
Quapropter firmiter dicimus asserimus et confitemur, nos qua-
dringentos florenos supradictos vt predicitur percepisse, et nos de
eisdem florenis fore ac esse pagatos in bono pondere et auro inte-
graliter et conplete pro reuerendissimo patre domino Nycolao
cardinali supradicto. Vnde nos predicta potestate diximus ac fecimus
ac in hiis scriptis dicimus et facimus a solucione mediorum fructuum
antedictorum eundem dominum .. cardinalem, necnon dominum ..
decanum et .. capitulum ecclesie herbipolensis, et dictam ec-
clesiam eorum de et super summa quadringentorum florenorum auri
prefatorum quitos omnino et totaliter liberos et solutos.
Jn cuius quitacionis solucionis ac liberacionis et omnium ac
singulorum premissorum robur euidens et testimonium sigillum
abbacye nostre supradicte maius ex certa nostra sciencia appendi
fecimus huic scripto.
Actum et datum anno dominj MCCCLXVIIIvo, feria secunda
proxima post dominicam Letare.
entries.english:
We, Brother Heilmann, abbot of the monastery of Schönau, of the Cistercian order, diocese of Worms, commissary or deputy in this matter of the reverend father in Christ and our lord Lord Johannes, bishop of Worms, nuncio of the apostolic see, commissary specially deputed by the same see for what is written below, subdeputed, publicly acknowledge and make clear in this writing to all and each whom it concerns or will concern, that we, in the place, stead and name of the same reverend father Lord Johannes, bishop of Worms, principal commissary, and also of the apostolic chamber and for the chamber itself, by the power specially handed to and enjoined on us by the same Lord Bishop Johannes, have received from the venerable men the lords dean and chapter of the church of Würzburg, on behalf of them and their said church and for them, four hundred florins of good weight and gold in ready, counted money, in our place and name of the same lords dean and chapter and their church, presented, given, assigned and handed over by the valiant esquires Eberhard the Younger von Rosenberg and Johannes the Younger von Rosenberg, in place of the half-fruits of the archdeaconry and prebend and also of the offerings, which the most reverend father in Christ Lord Nicolaus, bishop of Tusculum, cardinal of the holy Roman Church, archdeacon and canon of the aforesaid church of Würzburg, has in the same church, in which the dean and chapter aforesaid had been obligated to the same Lord Cardinal by reason of the lease made by them of the fruits of the archdeaconry, prebend and offerings aforesaid, in which four hundred florins in place of the half-fruits the aforesaid Lord Cardinal is also known to be obligated to the aforesaid apostolic chamber.
Wherefore we firmly say, assert and confess that we have received the four hundred florins aforesaid as stated, and that we are paid in good weight and gold completely and in full for the same florins for the most reverend father Lord Nicolaus the cardinal aforesaid. Hence by the aforesaid power we have said and done, and in this writing say and do, that the same Lord Cardinal, and also the lord dean and chapter of the church of Würzburg, and their said church, are entirely and totally acquitted, free and released from payment of the aforesaid half-fruits, concerning and regarding the sum of the aforesaid four hundred gold florins.
In evident strength and testimony of this acquittance, payment and release and of each and all of the foregoing, we have had the greater seal of our abbey aforesaid appended to this writing with our certain knowledge.
Done and given in the year of the Lord 1368, on the next Monday after the Sunday Laetare.

facts.content: presented the chapter's payment in lieu of half-fruits owed to Cardinal Nicolaus to Abbot Heilmann of Schönau as papal subcommissary.
presented the chapter's payment in lieu of half-fruits owed to Cardinal Nicolaus to Abbot Heilmann of Schönau as papal subcommissary.
received the payment for the apostolic chamber as subcommissary of Bishop Johannes of Worms and sealed the acquittance.
was acquitted, together with the Würzburg chapter, of payment of the half-fruits of his archdeaconry and prebend in Würzburg.
